findings.title: P1-3 rebuilds a cross-account search that already exists
findings.quote: **Global search** across accounts (library endpoint): group by account/area, deep link, saved searches | Search is per account; the operator must know where to look
findings.claim: The stated reason is false. The 'All' view (LibraryTab) already searches every account across notes, OCR text, contacts, calendar and seeds through /api/admin/library with an account filter and returns per-account hits. Only saved searches and URL-restorable deep links are missing.
findings.impact: P1 effort is spent recreating a working 883-line catalog UI, and the acceptance 'Query returns hits from 2 accounts' cannot distinguish old from new. Regression risk to the global catalog while P1-4 works the same data.
findings.verification_command: grep -n 'Search every note' src/admin/LibraryTab.jsx; grep -n 'view === "library"' src/admin/Admin.jsx
findings.fix: Restate P1-3 as 'saved searches + URL-restorable query/deep link on the existing /library view' and keep account/area grouping as-is.

findings.title: P0-2 acceptance is unmeasurable: 'downloaded' has two units and the real account has no matrix
findings.quote: Matrix equals `manifest.sqlite3` summary and file counts for `example.harvest`; screenshot; test for a zero-download account
findings.claim: The per-area live/exported/missing matrix already exists (OverviewTab renders verify.areas, with a clickable missing count). The acceptance asks it to equal both the manifest summary and file counts, which differ in the only real export: 113 done rows (104 photos + 9 hidden) versus 142 files under Photos (20 live-photo proxies plus 9 Hidden stills duplicated from Library); unique asset ids are 113. example.harvest also has verify:null, so screenshot 02 shows the empty 'Run Verify live' state, not a matrix.
findings.impact: P0-2 sign-off is a judgement call. A file-count implementation reports 29 more downloaded than a manifest implementation, so the operator's 'what is missing' answer changes with the unit; the demo provides no before/after evidence for the account with data.
findings.verification_command: sqlite3 export/example.harvest@icloud.com/manifest.sqlite3 'select area,count(*) from files where status="done" group by area;'; find export/example.harvest@icloud.com/Photos -type f | wc -l; find export/example.harvest@icloud.com/Photos -type f | xargs -n1 basename | cut -c1-36 | sort -u | wc -l
findings.fix: Fix the unit to unique asset id (proxies and cross-area duplicates excluded), require manifest-vs-disk side by side with an explicit diff, and add a fixture with a seeded failed row and a zero-download account.

findings.title: Crypto is described as a list filter but is a separate cross-account view with counts
findings.quote: Crypto filter | Shows only accounts with seed/private-key findings | `admin:list` with crypto flag, server-side aggregate
findings.claim: The Crypto control sets view='crypto', which renders CryptoTab over /api/admin/library?type=crypto; it is not a filter over admin:list. The view already shows per-account summary cards with seed/image/note/file counts, a match count, a seed count and an account filter.
findings.impact: P1-2's 'Crypto filter keeps next/prev match and count' is aimed at a control that does not exist, while the counts it asks for are already on screen. The real gap (no Crypto entry from an account detail; no walk from a phrase to its account) stays unaddressed.

findings.title: A restart strands every running job as 'unknown', so P0-1/P0-3 restart acceptance starts from a broken baseline
findings.claim: Store() calls markStaleJobs immediately, rewriting running/twofa to 'unknown'. The pool is constructed afterwards and its restart branch only requeues 'queued'/'running'. A probe with one running export job logs 'status after Store(): unknown', 'WorkerPool boot would requeue this job: false', and a trusted account flipped to connected with the job frozen. No retry or cancel event exists.
findings.impact: An operator who deploys or restarts during an export silently loses the job; an untrusted account shows 'sign-in was interrupted by a restart' despite a valid session. The planned jobs view would display 'unknown' forever and P0-3's 'order persists after restart' would fail on the first restart.
findings.fix: Requeue 'unknown' jobs as well as queued/running in the pool boot loop (or have markStaleJobs set 'queued' and let the pool re-dispatch), and keep the account's prior status.

findings.title: The Photos kind filter never refetches; the screenshot's 142/142 'Photo' result is stale
findings.claim: The reset/reload effect omits `kind`, so choosing a type updates the select but sends no request; the grid keeps the previous, unfiltered set. Screenshot 17 shows 'Photo' selected with '142 of 142' and the same 18 tiles as 03-photos.png, while a direct gallery(root, kind='photo') call returns total 0 and kindCounts {"unclassified":142}.
findings.impact: An operator selecting Seed phrase, Wallet or Crypto is shown all 142 media files and may conclude they are that kind. FEATURES' 'Photo filter returns the same proxies' is this bug read as data, which misdirects P1-1.
findings.fix: Add `kind` to the effect dependencies (and reload on it), and map 'unclassified' into the kind list so an empty index is visible rather than silent.

findings.title: P0-1 is scoped on two false premises: jobs are already durable, and 'failed' is not a status
findings.quote: **Jobs** are in-memory in the socket process and partially in the store; the console shows
findings.claim: Jobs are persisted in the store JSON (loaded on start, flushed with the newest 1000) and only the list/retry/cancel surface is missing. The P0-1 acceptance also requires a job in state 'failed', but the code writes queued/running/twofa/unknown/done/error/cancelled; 'failed' exists only for files in the SQLite manifest.
findings.impact: P0-1 is estimated and justified as durability work it does not need, and the acceptance test cannot be written literally. A jobs view that styles 'failed' leaves the real failure states (error, unknown, cancelled) unstyled.
findings.verification_command: grep -n 'for (const job of raw.jobs' server/store.js; grep -n 'slice(0, 1000)' server/store.js; grep -c 'status: "failed"' server/socket/worker-pool.js
findings.fix: State that jobs are durable, scope P0-1 to a list event + retry/cancel + last message, and use the real state names (or add a deliberate 'failed' mapping and migrate 'unknown').

findings.title: P0-3's persisted priority/note silently drops on reload unless two store whitelists change
findings.quote: 3 selected accounts produce 3 ordered jobs; order persists after restart; screenshot
findings.claim: updateAccount copies only a fixed key list and defaultAccount builds a fixed object, so a new priority/order/note field added only in the UI is discarded on the next store load (and by the socket's adminAccount round-trip). The term 'priority' is already used for the server-only PRIORITY_IMAGE_EMAILS fast-track, a different concept.
findings.impact: The badge and order look correct in-session and revert after reload or restart, exactly failing the stated acceptance while passing a naive click test.
findings.fix: Add queuePriority/priorityNote to defaultAccount and both updateAccount loops, sort the boot queue by it, and rename it away from the existing image fast-track.

findings.title: P0-4 cannot be delivered by dashboard code: the manifest has no reason/attempt and verify hides failed rows
findings.quote: **Download truth**: record per-file failures (path, reason, attempt) and surface "failed" separately from "missing"; retry a failure set
findings.claim: The manifest schema has key/area/path/size/sha256/status/updated only; a failed download writes status='failed' with size 0 and no reason. verify selects only status IN ('done','skipped'), so failed rows are counted as missing. Delivering P0-4 needs an exporter schema change + migration and a verify change, none of the dashboard files listed in scope.
findings.impact: A dashboard-only implementer can only invent reasons or show 'failed' from a flag that the pipeline does not carry; 'retry a failure set' cannot distinguish never-attempted from failed, which is the item's whole point.
findings.verification_command: sed -n '212,220p' python/worker/exporter.py; sed -n '28,31p' python/worker/verify.py; sed -n '957,962p' python/worker/exporter.py
findings.fix: Put exporter.py (add reason/attempts columns + migration) and verify.py in P0-4's scope, and define how retries are written back to the manifest.

findings.title: Acceptance criterion 4 is contradicted by the deliberate urls exemption
findings.quote: 4. `EXPORT_ENABLED=false` disables every export control; read-only actions still work.
findings.claim: worker.startExport deliberately allows mode='urls' when exports are disabled, and the Overview 'Photo URLs (no download)' button plus the Download URLs JSON anchor are not gated by exportEnabled. As written AC4 fails today; if 'urls' is exempt, 'every export control' has no definition.
findings.impact: Day-one sign-off depends on a private reading of 'export control'; an implementer may disable the only no-media path the operator uses, or leave a job queueable while the fleet is meant to be read-only.
findings.fix: Name the exempt control and its job mode in AC4, and gate or explicitly whitelist the Download URLs anchor in the same sentence.

findings.title: The inventory behind the plan is stale in at least four places the plan relies on
findings.quote: Rows are `div` + click; no keyboard/arrow navigation, no multi-select
findings.claim: Account rows are <button type="button"> (tab-focusable, Enter-activatable), so the keyboard baseline is wrong. The same section says submissions show 0 while 14-submissions.png lists TOTAL 5 and every row has an editable status select, says manual connect renders `[ ]` while it prints '(no cookies in this session)' and shows session.found/reason, and says admin:scan_all is not exposed while LibraryTab has a working 'Scan all' button.
findings.impact: P1-6's keyboard work and the operator's 'consolidate what exists' are sized from a document that was not re-checked against the Nov 12-14 build; the two headline cross-account views are partly or wholly missing from §2.
findings.verification_command: sed -n '80,88p' src/admin/Admin.jsx; grep -n 'Scan all' src/admin/LibraryTab.jsx; sed -n '189,193p' src/admin/ManualConnectModal.jsx; sed -n '184,194p' src/admin/Admin.jsx
findings.fix: Re-derive §2 from the current components before approving §4, and add the All (Library) view and the Crypto view to the inventory.

findings.title: The sidebar shows the legacy Submissions panel under the Crypto and All views
findings.quote: Legacy form submissions. Account data lives under Accounts.
findings.claim: The aside renders the submissions summary for every view except 'accounts' (and 'hidden'), so opening Crypto (screenshot 13) or All leaves 'TOTAL 5 / NEW 4 ...' beside an unrelated main pane.

findings.title: Ping, Verify live and Hide have no screenshot, and the All view is not captured
findings.claim: Three inventoried features are evidenced only by source (Ping #11, Verify live #13, Hide/Unhide #15), and the cross-account All/Library view has no screenshot in the tour (21 files). Verify is the control that answers 'what is missing', so its result state is never shown for any account with data.
findings.impact: The operator cannot see the outcome of the action the plan's P0-2 extends, and P0-2/P1-3 have no before-state to compare against. 'Screenshot every dashboard feature' is unmet even before the plan is implemented.
findings.fix: Capture Ping result, Verify result (with areas populated), Hide/Unhide and the All view with a global query before approving the plan.
